content.text:
metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.edit
  name: "Edit Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Edit menu for create, multi-edit, update-fields, version, and export workflows."

udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit"
kind: menu
type: "menu"
title: "Edit"

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.create-from-object"
    label: "Create From Object"
    description: "Create a new object based on the selected reference object."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-create-from-object"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.edit-create"

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.multi-edit"
    label: "Multi-Edit"
    description: "Edit multiple selected objects with type-compatible operations."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-edit-multi"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.edit-multi"

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.update-fields"
    label: "Update Fields"
    description: "Add missing mandatory fields and optional fields from registry or reference object."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-update-fields"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.create-new-version"
    label: "Create New Version"
    description: "Generate a new version of selected objects."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-update-version"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "5"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.insert-known-keys-values"
    label: "Insert Known Keys/Values"
    description: "Add registry-defined keys or values to selected objects."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-edit-registry-insert"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "6"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.export-as"
    label: "Export As"
    description: "Export object using custom file name or type."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-export-custom"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: "prismata.universe.menu.edit-export"

  - key: "7"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.edit.open-in-vile-editor"
    label: "Open in Vile Editor"
    description: "Edit selected object using the Vile editor. Only available for single-file edits."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-edit-vile"
    mode: "vile"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
